antispam.usage: Usage: /bc toggles sender-channel blocking; /bc allow <channel_id> allowlists and unbans a channel; /bc deny <channel_id> removes a channel from the allowlist.

ban.failed: ❌ Ban failed. The bot may be missing permission to ban users. Grant the permission, then try again.
ban.failure_alert: ⚠️ %[1]s failed: group %[2]d, target %[3]d (%[4]s), operator %[5]s. The bot may be missing permission to ban users. Grant the permission, then retry the action.

ban_time.permanent_description: banned users cannot rejoin this group
ban_time.set:
✅ Ban duration set to %[1]s (%[2]s).
/ban, /sb, and automatic bans after repeated verification failures use this duration.
ban_time.temporary_description: the user may submit another join request after the ban lifts
ban_time.usage:
Usage: /bantime <duration> sets the duration used by /ban, /sb, and automatic bans after repeated verification failures:
• /bantime 0 — permanent ban (does not lift automatically; the user cannot rejoin this group)
• /bantime 7d / 12h / 30m / 3600 — temporary ban (lifts automatically when the duration ends; the user may then submit another join request)
(d = days, h = hours, m = minutes, bare number = seconds; minimum 30 seconds)
